::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 7 1866  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55386 (1) P.230
:::

My dear Miss Yonge,

I return the France, which indeed I ought to have done yesterday, when I wrote you that I had seen the delegates.

I shall quite count on your doing the smaller book for us, as you kindly agree.

Mrs [Craik](people/person_378.qmd) suggests “Heroic Lives of all times &amp;.” I adhere to the [Book of Worthies](cmy_books/cmybook_80.qmd).

Yours very faithfully

[A. Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
